name: Five figures in a Tanka boat, and other sketches
summary:
A drawing by George Chinnery of a small crowded boat, steered by a boatwoman; with sketches of a Macanese woman, an upturned hat, and a pig.
On the back are three drawings of a figure between two pigs, and a drawing of an elderly seated man; inscribed in shorthand three times 'May 4th [18]39', once
